description: Deterministic mapping from each storefront's existing place/route identifier to a canonical Place/route anchor. Built only from values directly observed on each live storefront this pass (nadiairporttransfers/fijidash zones table; bookfijitransfers destinationId slugs from its own live API/bundle). No value was invented.

nadiairporttransfers_and_fijidash.note: Storefronts 1 and 2 share the exact same zones table (see inventory 01/02) — one mapping row covers both. ~55 named hotels each map to one of these zone anchors via ftt-booking-site/src/app.js's hotel table; only the zone-level anchors are listed here since that is the pricing-resolution granularity.
nadiairporttransfers_and_fijidash.identity_mapping: Each zones.name value IS the canonical route anchor already — no transformation needed for these two storefronts.

review_required.detail: bookfijitransfers.com's 'wailoaloa-nadi' slug rolls up multiple physical areas (Wailoaloa, Namaka, and unspecified 'Nadi hotels') under storefronts 1/2's single 'Wailoaloa' zone anchor. If 'Nadi hotels' in that grouping actually means storefronts 1/2's separate 'Nadi' zone (a different, slightly further zone than 'Wailoaloa' in the zones table), this mapping may be conflating two distinct canonical anchors into one. Not resolved — flagged for human confirmation of exactly which hotels bft's corridor covers.

hilton-denarau, sofitel-denarau, sheraton-denarau, radisson-denarau, and port-denarau all map to the single 'Denarau' anchor, matching storefronts 1/2's behavior (all Denarau hotels price identically there too) — EXCEPT port-denarau's live sedan fare (39) differs from the other four Denarau destinations (49), which is very likely the launch promo described in inventory 03, not a real distinct route. Treat as a promotional override on top of the Denarau anchor, not a separate anchor, pending confirmation.

bft's destinationId is literally 'natadola-intercontinental' but its display label is 'InterContinental Fiji & Yatule · Natadola' — grouping two named resorts (InterContinental, Yatule) under one anchor, consistent with storefronts 1/2 also treating InterContinental Natadola and Yatule Resort as the same 'Natadola' zone. No conflict found here, listed for completeness.
